notice: Python and SQLite on this page: the examples run in your browser, in Python 3.13.2 with SQLite 3.39.0, while the chapter was built and recorded under Python 3.14.6 with SQLite 3.53.1. The book's database sweigartcats.db is held on this page and checked by its hash. A time on this page is one run on one machine.
